title: Great App, only needs 1 fix
body: PLEASE fix the groups function. It does not allow you to delete or organize the groups on the top row which makes my top priority habit groups get randomly organized and kind of ruins the efficiency in using a group. I have many empty groups which won't delete automatically and which get in the way of the groups I actually do use. If you flesh out this feature then the app is flawless.

title: I use this constantly
body: While I do use this app constantly I'm not always consistent lol BUT it is helping me be more consistent at least. If you love a checklist then this app is for you! The one feature I'd like to expand is the mood tracking. I'd love the ability to track multiple mood entries per day and not just one, so I can see how certain parts of my day affected when/how I did things.

title: Discounted Lifetime Membership ($8.99) is well worth the price.
body: I'm a perfectionist and I've tried and dropped so many routine apps. This one is almost perfect. I really appreciate not having to set a specific day of the week for weekly or monthly tasks. The one thing that's missing is a feature for subtasks — for example, I like to put all my exercises under one task, and being able to name them instead of simply putting 5 per day would make it even better.

title: All I need!
body: I have used many Habit trackers and Task managers over the years. As I move into retirement I was looking for one that gave me flexibility, deep functionality and a lifetime license. I found all of that and more in Habit Tracker. I especially like the ability to create my own habits with a wide range of frequencies and units as well as colors and icons. The many built-in habits that directly read Apple health data are extremely useful!

title: First time user!
body: I really like the customization of this app! From the colors, themes, titles, to the ringtones! When I first downloaded the app I was given a discount on a lifetime membership for $8.99 and that's it! Yes that does seem like a lot for habit tracking, but it helps me and the type of person I am!

title: User Friendly Tool
body: This habit tracker is user friendly for me AND my tween daughter! It is very simple to setup/customize/edit habits! We love the sound effects & progress bars to keep us on track with that extra hit of dopamine, too! We really appreciate the skip feature, so our streaks across the weeks and months are not totally reset.

title: Perfect tracking app!
body: I have used this on and off the last few years. It has wonderful features and is very intuitive to use. I track things like my health or exercise exercises or water and you can also use it to quit habits if you would like. You can also see your progress in different charts, this is a very thoughtful app.

title: One of my favs
body: Have had this one for years and use it daily. Really love it. Would have been 5 stars except that sometime in 2025 they changed it to having to tap into the category and then tap again. It used to be you could just tap to the right of the category and it would add one. Now that same action completes it for the week and you have to go in and correct things. Annoying.

title: Phenomenal App. So affordable too!
body: This app is incredible. Everything I need and more, and the life time membership is a small fraction of the price of what some of the other apps charge per MONTH. The dev deserves every penny.

title: Love it!
body: I love this app and it's NOT a monthly subscription thing which is great! One thing though. Is there an option in the 'goal period' to have something not only as daily but as like how many times a day it needs to be done. Like my skincare I would like it 2x a day.
